newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala May consumer prices rise 0.16 percent.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala May consumer prices rise 0.16 percent.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 0.16 percent in May, compared with a rise of 0.63 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute said on Tuesday.
April prices dropped 0.06 percent this year.
Accumulated inflation was 3.56 percent at the end of May compared with 4.73 percent a year ago, the institute said.
Year-over-year inflation was 9.61 percent on May 31, down from 10.13 percent as of April 30. Year-over-year inflation at the end of May 1996 was 11.02 percent.
